rv.q: WILD CHILD is a superb first draft, promising subsequent future productions could only get even better from here.
A captivating world premiere of the heartfelt contemporary musical “Wild Child” kick started Laguna Playhouse’s fall season Saturday night, Sept. 12.

It is a beautiful, uneven, and utterly engrossing piece of theater, serving as a powerful, melodic reminder of the shared resilience, hope, and messy humanity that no algorithm can ever truly replicate.
